ud5.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud5.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākaccāyano avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate.
ud5.6:1.4: tena kho pana samayena soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmato mahākaccānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud5.6:2.1: atha kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:2.2: “yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
ud5.6:2.3: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
ud5.6:3.1: atha kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāyano tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:4.1: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīṇassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:4.2: ‘yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti. nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
ud5.6:4.3: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya’nti.
ud5.6:5.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahākaccāyano soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ kuṭikaṇṇaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:5.2: “dukkaraṃ kho soṇa, yāvajīvaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ,
ud5.6:5.3: iṅgha tvaṃ soṇa, tattheva āgārikabhūto samāno buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja, kālayuttaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ”ti.
ud5.6:5.4: atha kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajjābhisaṅkhāro so paṭipassambhi.
ud5.6:6.1: dutiyampi kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: “yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti. nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ. yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti. dutiyampi kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāyano tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ etadavoca: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: ‘yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ. yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti. “pabbājetu maṃ bhante, ayyo mahākaccāyano”ti.
ud5.6:6.2: dutiyampi kho āyasmā mahākaccāyano soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ kuṭikaṇṇaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:6.3: “dukkaraṃ kho soṇa, yāvajīvaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ.
ud5.6:6.4: iṅgha tvaṃ soṇa, tattheva agārikabhūto samāno buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja, kālayuttaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ”ti.
ud5.6:6.5: dutiyampi kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajjābhisaṅkhāro so paṭippassambhi.
ud5.6:7.1: tatiyampi kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa rahogatassa patisallīṇassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:7.2: ‘yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti. nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ,
ud5.6:7.3: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
ud5.6:7.4: tatiyampi kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāyano tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantānaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:7.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:8.1: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīṇassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:8.2: “yathā yathā kho ayyo mahākaccāyano dhammaṃ deseti. nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ,
ud5.6:8.3: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
ud5.6:9.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāyano soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ kuṭikaṇṇaṃ pabbājesi.
ud5.6:9.2: tena kho pana samayena avantidakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti.
ud5.6:9.3: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāyano tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ upasampādesi.
ud5.6:10.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa vassaṃ vutthassa rahogatassa patisallīṇassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:10.2: “na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho, api ca suto yeva me
ud5.6:10.4: sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyya, gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddha”nti.
ud5.6:11.1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākaccāyano tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:11.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:12.1: idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīṇassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi,
ud5.6:12.2: “na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho, api ca suto yeva me
ud5.6:12.3: so bhagavā īdiso ca īdiso cā’ti.
ud5.6:12.4: sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyya, gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti
ud5.6:13.2: gaccha tvaṃ soṇa, taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddha”nti.
ud5.6:13.3: dakkhissasi tvaṃ soṇa, taṃ bhagavantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamasamathadamathamanuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
ud5.6:13.4: disvāna mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihārañca puccha:
ud5.6:13.5: upajjhāyo me bhante, āyasmā mahākaccāyano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihārañca pucchatī”’ti.
ud5.6:14.1: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmato mahākaccāyanassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
ud5.6:14.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:14.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.6:14.4: “upajjhāyo me bhante, āyasmā mahākaccāyano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihārañca pucchatī”ti.
ud5.6:15.1: kacci bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ? kacci yāpanīyaṃ? kacci’si appakilamathena addhānaṃ āgato? na ca piṇḍakena kilantosī?”ti.
ud5.6:15.2: khamanīyaṃ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṃ bhagavā, appakilamathena cāhaṃ bhante, addhānaṃ āgato na ca piṇḍakena kilantomhī”ti.
ud5.6:16.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud5.6:16.5: imassā’nanda, āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehī’ti. icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ. icchati bhagavā āyasmatā soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ,
ud5.6:16.6: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati tasmiṃ vihāre āyasmato soṇassa senāsanaṃ paññāpesi.
ud5.6:17.1: atha kho bhagavā bahudevarattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
ud5.6:17.2: āyasmā’pi kho soṇo bahudevarattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
ud5.6:17.3: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ ajjhesi,
ud5.6:18.1: evaṃ, bhante’ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbāneva sarena abhaṇi.
ud5.6:18.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi:
ud5.6:18.3: sādhu! sādhu! bhikkhu, suggahitāni bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni supadhāritāni, kalyāṇiyāsi vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
ud5.6:18.6: kissa pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evaṃ ciraṃ akāsī?”ti.
ud5.6:18.8: api ca sambādho gharāvāso bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo”ti.
ud5.6:19.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
